validity_requirements: p3-assigned is the local alias of replicate-new. The supplied visible facts explicitly say its measurements have not been collected or revealed: D0004, s-ca93c783189132c0-p0001.txt, original line 2, bytes [2,272). The known published assays remain separate.

Before collecting the replication, specify the downstream endpoint and drug-versus-comparator contrast. Preserve outcome 0 as 'assigned downstream response is lost or lower' and outcome 1 as 'assigned downstream response is retained'. A lower absolute signal must not be confused with loss of a drug-associated suppressive response.
Use the planned matched-donor comparisons and document donor identities, pairing across assays and relationship to the published donor panels. Technical replicates do not replace independent donors.

A source-grounded acute replication can use the reported 30-minute pretreatment and 1-hour stimulation with TGFβ1 2 ng/mL. Exact nerandomilast exposure, the PGE2 treatment branch and formulation still require specification; other assay schedules must remain separate.

For interpretation, verify stimulation response, viable cell/protein input, antibody and IgG controls, co-IP normalization and CUT&RUN input normalization. These are proposed requirements, not controls known to have passed in replicate-new.

The two outcome entries below describe interpretable future measurements conditional on adequate assay performance and precision. Failed assays, insufficient precision or context mismatch must remain measurement_failure, insufficient_precision or not_applicable in a subsequent result review, rather than being forced into a mechanistic contradiction.

No numerical separation or equivalence threshold can be derived from the supplied summaries. Establish the relevant effect contrast and donor-level uncertainty before treating non-detection as evidence against an expectation.

observation_reviews.explanatory_adequacy: Supports drug-associated MKP1 abundance change. It does not establish protein stabilization, MKP1 activity or mediation.
observation_reviews.next_check: Preserve this as background for the assigned replication. To test hA causally in a separately specified follow-up, compare the drug response under effective selective MKP1 reduction and matched control, with restoration/rescue and viability controls. Perturbation specifications are not supplied and must not be invented.

Attenuation of the drug effect with appropriate rescue would support a contribution; residual response would remain compatible with partial MKP1 mediation and parallel pathways.

Measure the chosen SMAD3/co-IP/CUT&RUN contrasts with their source-specific controls and units; preserve SERPINE1 and CDKN1A separately. This tests reproducibility.
